name: Ultra Gobi 400K
blurb: China's first non-stop, self-navigated, self-supported ultra. Four days of continuous movement across the Gobi. I finished holding hands with Jack Carey, and raised more than $10,000 for Live Oak Camp scholarships along the way.

name: The Speed Project Solo, LA → Las Vegas
blurb: A third solo crossing from Santa Monica to Las Vegas, this time as part of Team Solo.

name: Moab 240
blurb: I entered the lottery while my wife was pregnant, and ran it when our daughter was about two and a half months old. The last stretch of training happened as a new parent.

name: The Speed Project Solo, LA → Las Vegas
blurb: I ran the solo, and then a few days later turned around and ran the relay on the same route.

name: The Speed Project Relay, LA → Las Vegas
blurb: The relay, run days after finishing the same route solo.

name: The Speed Project Solo, Atacama
location: Iquique → San Pedro de Atacama, Chile
blurb: The longest of my solo crossings, across the driest desert on earth. I decided late that the cost and the missed Thanksgiving were worth it.

name: The Speed Project Solo, LA → Las Vegas
blurb: My first attempt at anything beyond 100 miles. Santa Monica to Las Vegas, crewed by nine women, and I won it outright.
